# ExamGhost: full product description

> ExamGhost is an AI Chrome extension that answers quiz and homework questions directly on the web page. It is made by FoundryOne LLC (Albuquerque, New Mexico) and uses a Gemini-based AI model. Free tier: 5 solves a day, no card required.

Last updated: 2026-11-19
Website: https://www.examghost.com
Support: support@examghost.com

## What is ExamGhost?

ExamGhost is a Google Chrome extension for students that reads a quiz or homework question on the page and returns an answer generated by a Gemini-based AI model. It can fill in the answer, highlight the correct option, copy it to the clipboard, or show a step-by-step explanation in a side panel. It is built by FoundryOne LLC, a company based in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA.

Who it is for: high school and college students who use online learning platforms such as Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle or publisher homework sites and want quick answers or worked explanations while studying.

## How does ExamGhost work?

1. Install the extension in Google Chrome.
2. Open a page with a question, such as a quiz or homework assignment.
3. Double-click the question. ExamGhost reads the question text and answer options and sends them to the AI model.
4. The answer is delivered according to the active solver mode: filled in, highlighted, or explained.

For questions that are images, graphs or diagrams, press Alt+S and drag a box around the area to snip a screenshot; ExamGhost solves from the image. You can also scan the whole page to solve every detected question at once.

## Features

- Double-click to solve: supports multiple choice, multi-select, dropdown and short answer questions.
- Three solver modes, switched with keyboard shortcuts:
  - Alt+1, Quick: fills in the answer and copies it to the clipboard, with no panel.
  - Alt+2, Highlight: marks the correct option with a check mark.
  - Alt+3, Explain: fills in the answer and opens a side panel with step-by-step reasoning.
- Answer delivery: auto-fill, highlight, or clipboard copy.
- Alt+S screenshot snip: solve graphs, diagrams and image-based questions.
- Page scan: solve all questions on the current page.
- Equation and LaTeX reading for math and science questions.
- Tuned prompts for 13 subjects: math, physics, chemistry, biology, computer science, economics, history, accounting/business, geography, literature, psychology/civics, English, and logic.
- Master on/off switch in the extension popup.

## What data does ExamGhost send?

Data is sent only when the user triggers a solve. On a solve, the question text (and answer options) is sent to an AI service to generate the answer. When the user uses Alt+S, a screenshot of the selected area only is sent. The master on/off switch in the popup turns the extension off. Full details: https://www.examghost.com/privacy

## What are ExamGhost's limitations?

- Answers come from an AI model and can be wrong. Check important answers yourself, especially multi-step math and questions that depend on course-specific material.
- Instructors may restrict or prohibit AI tools on graded work. Users are responsible for following their school's academic integrity policy and their instructor's rules.
- It runs in Google Chrome only on pages it can read; unusual question formats may not be detected, in which case the Alt+S screenshot snip can be used.
